title: Daily Temperatures
statement:
Given daily temperatures, return an array where answer[i] is the number of days until a warmer day.
If there is no warmer day ahead, use 0.
hints: Brute force checks every later day. Can you avoid looking at the same days again and again?
Keep a stack of days still waiting for a warmer day. Their temperatures go down from bottom to top.
When today is warmer than the day on top, pop it and record the gap. Repeat, then push today.

solution.approach: Use a monotonic decreasing stack of indices. For each day, while it is warmer than the day on top, pop that index and set its answer to the distance. Push the current index.

analogy: people in a cinema queue waiting for someone taller to block their view
